rca_of_issue: Reproduced on fresh preview loads at 390x844 and after Expo restart. Browser console, Expo error overlay, and toast all show the warning with source location index.tsx:45:47, but that location is the root conditional return rather than the actual offending child. Replacing the Icon renderer previously did not remove it, so inspect all JSX siblings/conditional whitespace in index.tsx and child components, then retest with console capture.
